title: A reply from the MettleUp team reaches only the browser the question was sent from
what: Questions sent from Help and feedback carry no name or mobile number, and the team's reply can be fetched only by the same browser that sent it. An owner who asks from the desk computer and later looks on a phone, a new computer, or after clearing the browser never sees the reply, and nothing else tells the gym a reply came. After 30 newer questions an old one is dropped and its reply is lost too. A 'delete our gym' request sent the same way gets its answer the same way.
expected: A reply from MettleUp reaches the gym wherever the owner signs in, for example tied to the gym and the person who asked, or also shown in the gym's notification bell.
who: owners and desk staff who ask MettleUp for help
how_often: every time the person who asked looks from another device or browser
fix_line: Keep each question with the gym and the person who asked, so the reply shows wherever they sign in

title: A gym that pays MettleUp by UPI gets no warning before its plan ends
what: The 'your MettleUp plan ends in N days' reminder on Today shows only while online paying is switched on. The plan-ended banner and its limits follow a different switch. With limits on and online paying off (the page then says to pay by UPI or bank transfer), the owner hears nothing until the plan has already ended and the 7 extra days have started, and MettleUp has to chase each gym by hand.
expected: Every owner whose plan is near its end sees the reminder, with the way to pay that is open at the time.
who: owners who pay MettleUp by UPI or bank transfer
how_often: every plan end while online paying is off
fix_line: Show the plan-end reminder whenever the plan has an end date, pointing to whichever way of paying is open

items.reason: these files hold no account, domain, signing key or token; they only pass the device's sign-in key to the site's own help and AI matching addresses
